IEEE ICDM 2026 · Industrial Tutorial 6

Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting with LLMs

From Pattern Recognition to Cognitive Reasoning

November 15, 202610:10–12:10 · UTC+8Grand Ballroom 1 · Shenyang, China

Overview

This tutorial explores how large language models bring context and reasoning to time series forecasting. We cover multimodal understanding, reasoning over predictive evidence, and agentic interaction with tools and environments, with applications in energy, traffic, industry, and science.
